_comment: The gift pack drop (Game loop architecture, Decisions, "Gift pack drop", task T-144): on each level-up a helicopter flies across the screen and drops a package that lands a short way ahead of the car, on open road; driving over it opens the level-up screen. Proposed numbers; the board judges them in playtests. Drawn pixels are the isometric view's pixels (the car is 3 units = 48 world pixels long); units are the car's width, as everywhere.

helicopter._comment: speed_px_per_second: how fast it flies across, in drawn pixels per second. drop_height_px: how far above the landing spot it flies, and so how far the package falls (less when the landing spot is near the top of the screen: the helicopter never flies above the screen's top edge). offscreen_margin_px: how far beyond the screen's left and right edges it starts and ends, so it enters and leaves out of sight.

package._comment: fall_seconds: time from the drop to the landing. land_ahead_units: how far ahead of the car (along the way it is moving, or its nose when standing still) the package lands. clearance_units: the open road needed around the landing spot (no building, boulder or map edge within it). pickup_radius_units: the car picks the package up when its centre comes this close to the package's.
